name: Voice providers
description: Speech for agents: built-in, or Grok, ElevenLabs and OpenAI with your API key.
integration.summary: Built-in voice by default; cloud providers when you choose them.
integration.example: Check which voice providers I have connected
settings.providerHint: Built-in is the default and needs no external key. Cloud errors fall back to the built-in engine, which requires installed models and WAV for recognition. Cloud speech sends text or recordings to the service and uses API credits. Voices are AI-generated.
settings.openaiModelHint: Realtime models use the Realtime API. Legacy tts-1 / gpt-4o-mini-tts use Speech API until its announced shutdown on 6 January 2027.
settings.voiceHint: A voice ID from this provider. Grok: eve, ara, rex, sal, leo. OpenAI Realtime: cedar, marin, alloy, ash, ballad, coral, echo, sage, shimmer, verse.
error.key: Connect the selected provider’s API key in Voice providers. It is stored in the vault.
error.auth: The provider rejected the key or access. Check the key and account permissions.
error.quota: The voice provider’s balance or request limit is exhausted. Check billing or try later.
error.request: Check the selected speech model, voice and input format in Voice providers.
error.unavailable: The voice provider is unavailable. Check the connection and try again.
error.timeout: The voice provider did not finish within 45 seconds. Try again.
error.response: The voice provider returned an incomplete or unreadable result. Try again.
error.busy: Four voice requests are already running. Try again shortly.
setup.hint: Only add keys for services you choose. Keys go straight into the vault, never into settings or chat.
